_source: near_identical: the title cosine (similarity model) at or above which action_center._same_story calls two issues one story. Fitted by backend/scripts/calibrate_near_identical.py (action_center.fit_near_identical_cut) on pairs the stored issues label themselves: the same source article, national monitor or bill is one story, different monitors on different days are two, other pairs left out; the lowest cosine no different-story pair reaches, plus CUT_MARGIN, with at least MIN_HARD_NEGATIVES such pairs. The refresh refits it daily. This snapshot held 1 different-story pairs, under 30, so the value in use (0.92, hand-measured on 120 pairs in 2026-07, labels not kept) stands until the data supply enough.
